data.narrative:
Breen Energy is a seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $3M to date. The Climate & Energy sector includes 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers, among them Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables to support a reliable peer-median valuation.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($3M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $8M. This method rests on the assumption that the company's $3M raise reflects investor consensus on current worth and that sector-standard progression multiples hold.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with $8M as the median estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-stage peer data—reliance on a single method limits triangulation robustness—and the unknown market conditions and capital efficiency metrics specific to Breen Energy. Any material information on revenue trajectory, IP strength, or founder track record would refine this range materially.
